summary: Calibrate once, prepare the plate at HOME, then carry it to Hamilton.

steps.label: Run full calibration once; finish at IDLE holding the plate
Verify the held plate and the checked IDLE-to-HOME route
Place the plate in HOME and verify it is fully supported
Lift 5 mm at speed 5, then open E1 to 28 mm; verify the full sweep
Rotate the released holder to the taught absolute E2 90.717 degrees
Verify three fresh holder-angle readings before re-gripping
Re-grip using the accepted Hamilton plate profile
Lift 5 mm slowly and verify plate retention
Follow the reviewed route to Hamilton; retain the slower final approach
